entries.subject: Lunch at Gino's before I skedaddle
entries.body:
Hi all,

Just wanted to organise a lunch before I go as it'll be nice to see everyone before I head off. If there's a bit of a better time for everyone just let me know and feel free to pass on the invite to anyone else 🙂

Beth
entries.ai_note: Bethany Gray is organizing a farewell lunch and asking Kevin to confirm his availability.
